observable_failure_step.description: academic-orchestrator dispatched statistics-agent / academic-writer with hardcoded unrevised fit indices, overriding the canonical metrics from fit_measures_sem.csv.

root_cause_diagnosis: Root Cause 1 (Parallel Script Forking & Constraint Drift): compute_stage45_macro_sem.R deviated from run_full_sem.R by introducing ad-hoc fixed error variances, inequality lower bounds, and MLR estimation instead of citing the accepted revised model. Root Cause 2 (Orchestrator CDE Anchoring Blindspot): academic-orchestrator ingested unrevised payload numbers into CDE acceptance criteria without cross-referencing against 02_analysis_code/fit_measures_sem.csv. Root Cause 3 (Circular Validator Hardcoding): validate_stage45_macro_sem.py checked deliverable JSON against CDE criteria rather than against the canonical statistical source of truth on disk (fit_measures_sem.csv), issuing an unearned mechanical pass.
prescribed_behavior: For statistics-agent (sem skill): Do not fork scripts to apply ad-hoc constraints; load and cite fit_measures_sem.csv as the single source of truth for Stage 4.5. For academic-orchestrator: Do not hardcode raw fit indices in task delegation envelopes; instead, mandate verification against canonical files on disk. For validation-agent: Write assertions that verify deliverables against physical data sources (e.g., fit_measures_sem.csv) rather than circularly checking them against the orchestrator's expectations.
